results.text: The safety of prolonged indomethacin therapy. The purpose of this study was to describe the fetal and newborn safety profile of prolonged indomethacin treatment during pregnancy. A retrospective cohort of 124 pregnant women treated with indomethacin was used to assess the outcomes of oligohydramnios, constriction of the ductus arteriosus, and composite neonatal morbidity. Side effect and safety data for fenbufen. The overall safety pattern of fenbufen has been evaluated in a total of 2,667 patients: 1,667 of them in domestic clinical studies and 1,000 in foreign pivotal studies. Comparisons of several hundred patients--each receiving aspirin, indomethacin, and placebo--were made.
